title: cli: `os package publish` silently drops the `tags`, `publisher` and `isStarter` keys `objectstack.manifest.json` declares (inherited from CreatePackageRequestSchema), so an author's listing tags never reach the catalog
body:
epic:#27293#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcVBKAFk1ntXSjvPt7U

Filing gate: ① a product defect with a named location, `finding` class (c) (a trap that leads an AI author to write metadata that is silently dropped). Found by the os-dev on #27240 (report on that card; PR #27321 Acceptance notes) and re-measured by this seat. ⛔ Not a claim.

`reach:` named real producer: `objectstack-ai/hotcrm` `objectstack.manifest.json` at `353dace` carries `tags`, `publisher` and `isStarter` (read by the #27240 dev and by this seat's premise agent, 2026-10-28).

## The defect

- `TemplateManifestSchema` (`packages/spec/src/marketplace/template-manifest.zod.ts:21-54`) is `CreatePackageRequestSchema.omit({ ownerOrgId, createdBy, namespace, manifestId }).extend(…)`, so it accepts every other create-request key, among them `tags`, `publisher` and `isStarter` (`packages/spec/src/marketplace/package.zod.ts:310-315`).
- `os package publish` reads only `manifestId`, `displayName`, `description`, `category`, `tagline`, `iconUrl`, `homepageUrl`, `license`, `readmePath` and `translations` from the file. Re-check: `git grep -n -E "\b(tags|publisher|isStarter)\b" origin/main -- packages/cli/src/commands/package/publish.ts` → 0 property reads (the one `publisher` hit, line 203, is a comment); control `git grep -c displayName origin/main -- packages/cli/src/commands/package/publish.ts` → 5.
- Reverse leg: publish reads and sends a top-level `tagline` the template schema does not declare.
- `preview.*` (`template-manifest.zod.ts:111`) is likewise never sent: publish uploads no screenshots. That is a documented scaffold-side key, so it is listed here only for the dev to classify.

Read at `origin/main` `65b49208`, 2026-10-28T16:25Z.

## Business reason

An app author (an AI agent, per the North Star) writes `tags` and `isStarter` in the listing file because the schema and the generated reference page accept them; the catalog then shows none of it, and nothing says why. This is the declared-but-not-enforced shape the enforce-or-remove channel exists for: either publish sends the keys, or the file's schema stops accepting them.

## Reader

The triage seat routes it (`domain:server` for `packages/cli`, or `domain:spec` if the fix narrows `TemplateManifestSchema`); the fix's direction is enforce-or-remove, and choosing between the two is triage's call or the maintainer's.

## Dedupe

- Semantic search "os package publish ignores objectstack.manifest.json tags publisher isStarter preview keys silently dropped template manifest", all states: 10 shown of 31, none this defect (nearest: #26708 closed, phantom package ids; #26642 closed, npm names).
- The 500 most recent issues and PRs, titles grepped for `manifest|publish|isStarter|tagline`: 10 hits, none this defect.
